scripts.dev:agent: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @rupa/agent build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env services/agent/dist/main.js
scripts.demo: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @rupa/agent build && forge build --root contracts && node scripts/local-demo.mjs
scripts.setup:demo: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @rupa/agent build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/setup-demo.mjs
